sections.heading: How To Use?
sections.text:
Take a sufficient amount of sunscreen and apply it evenly over your moisturized skin. Allow the sunscreen to set for a few minutes before applying makeup or going outside.

Reapply sunscreen every two hours for effective results. 

CAUTION : Discontinue use if irritation occurs. Even natural ingredient may cause allergies to some. Patch test is recommended on elbow before use. Store in cool & dry

place. Avoid contact with eyes, if contact occurs, rinse well

with cool water.

 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 **🌞 Studd Muffyn Sun Kissed Mousse Duo

Experience a new-age Korean-inspired sunscreen mousse that seamlessly melts into your skin within seconds — giving you weightless protection with an instant glow.

This combo features Studd Muffyn Sun Kissed Mousse SPF50++ Mango Mania and Studd Muffyn Sun Kissed Mousse SPF70++ Bubblegum Blast — two multitasking skin protectors that shield your skin from harmful UV rays while supporting a bright, youthful, even-toned complexion.

The featherlight, ultra-smooth mousse texture glides effortlessly, delivering a silky, seamless finish with zero white cast.Perfect for daily wear, this duo ensures sun protection that feels luxurious, quick-absorbing, and unbelievably soft on the skin.

Korean innovation crafted for India — for sun protection that looks as good as it feels.

sections.heading: FAQ
sections.text:
collapsible-row-list-item__label">
 

 
 FAQ
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 1. Is this sunscreen suitable for all skin types?

Yes, the mousse formula is lightweight, non-greasy, and works beautifully on all skin types—including oily, dry, and sensitive skin.

2. Does it leave a white cast?

Not at all! The Korean-inspired mousse melts instantly into the skin for a smooth, invisible finish.

3. Can I use it under makeup?

Absolutely. It doubles as a perfect makeup primer—just blend it with your foundation for a flawless base.

4. How much SPF protection does it offer?

It provides SPF50++ with strong UVA + UVB protection, keeping your skin safe from sun damage.

5. Is the fragrance too strong since it’s Mango Mania?

No, it has a mild, refreshing mango scent that fades quickly after application.

6. How often should I reapply?

Reapply every 3–4 hours if you're outdoors for extended periods.

7. Does it help improve the skin over time?

Yes! With regular use, it helps reduce dullness, tanning build-up, and dryness caused by sun exposure.

8. Is this really the first mousse sunscreen in India?

It is one of the first Korean-inspired mousse sunscreens in India with 2 Lac+ happy customers trusting the formula.
